stations.title: The ticket

captions: The ticket printer at the hut. Bridie sells a ticket to two adults and three children.
Today the printer glues the two counts together and checks nothing on the ticket.
You join, cut, measure and compare the ticket's text, in four small tasks.
Now the ticket shows the right party and code, and says whether it is for today's boat.
Text has its own rules. The tickets come out right.
